dedupe_keys.name: bdnb base de donnees nationale des batiments france

description: The BDNB, Base de Données Nationale des Bâtiments, is a national building database for France set up by the Centre Scientifique et Technique du Bâtiment because, according to the site, there was no official French database combining spatial and attribute data on buildings. It is built by geospatially cross-matching about twenty databases from public bodies and gives an identity card for more than 32 million residential and tertiary buildings. CSTB enriches it with derived information such as probable energy performance diagnostics (DPE), the effect of energy condition on sale prices and heat island indicators. Intended uses listed include the ecological transition, energy renovation, heat island modelling, prioritising social housing, evaluating public aid and simplifying network connections. Coverage: France. Access: an open data version with exports split by département in GeoPackage, SQL or CSV, plus API and bulk export offers and the Go Rénove application. Licence: not stated on the page read; the open data version is free, and API and study services are offered commercially. Caveats: many attributes are modelled or matched, not observed, so each field's source and confidence should be checked. Simulation uses are building stock energy and renovation scenarios and building-level exposure for heat and flood risk. Related records: the ADEME energy performance diagnostics data.
